stage0072_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「You truly won't stop this war, no matter what?」

stage0072_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$シャア$$
「I've already said all I can say on that.」

stage0072_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「Isn't the armistice with $c
　the first step toward a cease-fire?」

stage0072_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$シャア$$
「It's solely to search for the singularity.
　They understand that as well.」

stage0072_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$シャア$$
「Even I understand that $$エタニティ・フラット$$
　is an obstacle all mankind must face.」

stage0072_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's also why I actively exchange
　information with Dr. $$トライア$$, an authority
　in hyperspace physics.」

stage0072_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「I believe that war itself is also a
　problem all mankind must confront.」

stage0072_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$シャア$$
「Vice Minister Darlian...
　I do value your ideals.
　But I face reality as it is.」

stage0072_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「You mean... the existence of Chrono.」

stage0072_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's right.
　This world is moved from the shadows by an
　organization even you don't fully grasp.」

stage0072_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$シャア$$
「And its spearhead is turned toward the Spacenoids.」

stage0072_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「Did you start this war
　just to destroy Chrono?」

stage0072_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$シャア$$
「I wouldn't go that far
　just to strike at one person, or a group.」

stage0072_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$シャア$$
「I intend to see... beyond that.」

stage0072_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's right.
　I want to open a path for mankind to advance.」

stage0072_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$シャア$$
「I don't mean to confuse you with abstract idealism.」

stage0072_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$シャア$$
「Thank you, Vice Minister Darlian.
　Even unofficially, having this chance
　to exchange words meant a great deal to me too.」

stage0072_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$... you are...」

stage0072_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$シャア$$
「Would you laugh, call me $$トレーズ$$'s tail-end?」

stage0072_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「But I cannot approve of you
　for choosing war as your method.」

stage0072_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$シャア$$
「It's not me that $$トレーズ$$ entrusted
　the future to. It's you.」

stage0072_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「...Do you wish to become a loser too?」

stage0072_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's not it.
　I intend to win the future.」

stage0072_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$シャア$$
（Yes...
　That seems to be my role...）

stage0072_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You went to rile up the enemy's rage,
　and came back sympathizing instead...?
　Come on, $$アンナロッタ$$...」

stage0072_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「If you wanted to blow off steam,
　you could've gone somewhere unrelated to them...
　Well... you brought it on yourself.」

stage0072_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Go back to your own room.
　You know as well as I do that wanting
　comfort here is barking up the wrong tree.」

stage0072_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「...Pour me one too.」

stage0072_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Nuh-uh.
　Besides, running to drink isn't like you.」

stage0072_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「And what about you, then...」

stage0072_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Told you, didn't I?
　I just drink because I like it.」

stage0072_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「The line between rage and resignation melts
　together in this glass... That's my life.」

stage0072_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「So that's... what makes you
　similar to $F...」

stage0072_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So you met that Imitation Boy, huh...」

stage0072_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Stop overlaying planet Geminai onto this world's plight.」

stage0072_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Well, it's fine.
　They have no way to break the Prison of Time...」

stage0072_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「November 11th, by this world's calendar...
　the Prison of Time, and the eternal
　paradise, will both be complete.」

stage0072_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「I can't accept something like that as mercy...」

stage0072_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Right～?
　That's exactly why we're the ones acting.」

stage0072_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Drop out of the operation?
　It's not like your body belongs to you alone...」

stage0072_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Just kidding.
　I know your personality well enough.」

stage0072_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「A slow death is cruel.
　So a clear-cut end would
　be far kinder, I'd say.」

stage0072_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「To hell with a god's mercy.」

stage0072_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Though before that, the star of ill omen
　fills the sky... And then, people will despair
　at their own powerlessness.」

stage0072_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Now... a toast to god and devil!」

stage0072_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「That's right, $$グーラ$$.
　Soon, the star of ill omen will fill the sky.」

stage0072_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Then, Earthlings will know true despair.」

stage0072_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Yes.
　I decided to take Earth by my own power.」

stage0072_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$グーラ$$
「However much power those you
　speak of, Father, may hold, I won't
　let them do as they please.」

stage0072_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Then hurry, $$グーラ$$.
　Show me your power before that time comes.」

stage0072_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「I'm counting on you, my son.」

stage0072_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ロビー$$
「Earthlings are lesser life in the end...
　Unable to surpass the Age of the Sun,
　they'll never reach Lord $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s realm, or theirs.」

stage0072_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Will I go there myself, someday...」

stage0072_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ロビー$$
「By rights, it's where all intelligent life is bound.」

stage0072_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$グーラ$$
「...Tell $$ダンカン$$.
　I'm moving every unit I command.」

stage0072_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ロビー$$
「Understood.
　The all-out assault, at last.」

stage0072_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$グーラ$$
（Wait for me, $$正太郎$$.
　I'll settle things with you before
　any needless interference gets in the way.）

stage0072_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hey, $$正太郎$$...
　About today's math homework...」

stage0072_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Let me guess.
　You were thinking about $$グーラ$$ again, right?」

stage0072_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「No point thinking about him when
　he's not around. Come on, let's do homework.」

stage0072_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$柿小路$$
「In the President's case, wouldn't you
　just be copying $$正太郎$$'s homework?」

stage0072_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$郁絵$$
「No snacks if you don't do it on your own!」

stage0072_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「By the way, what's today's snack?」

stage0072_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$郁絵$$
「It's Mont Blanc, which $$正太郎$$ loves.」

stage0072_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Now that I know that, I'm all fired up.
　Wait for me, Mont Blanc!」

stage0072_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$タケル$$
「Watching $$正太郎$$ reminds me
　of things with $$マーグ#pilot$$...」

stage0072_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「$$マーグ#pilot$$ is $$タケル$$'s older brother, isn't he?」

stage0072_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「That's right.
　He was a kind, strong man.」

stage0072_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$マーグ#pilot$$ had his mind controlled
　by Emperor $$ズール$$, fought as our enemy,
　and then...」

stage0072_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「So that's how it was...」

stage0072_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「We only ever knew... that your
　brother had passed away...」

stage0072_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$タケル$$
「Don't make that face, $$ミレーヌ$$.
　$$マーグ#pilot$$ still lives on in
　my heart, and $$ロゼ$$'s too.」

stage0072_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$タケル$$
「But I don't want $$正太郎$$ and $$グーラ$$
　to repeat the sorrow $$マーグ#pilot$$
　and I went through.」

stage0072_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「But that's a tall order...
　his father, the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, has drilled the
　mission to conquer Earth into Prince $$グーラ$$.」

stage0072_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「A parent forcing their child's way
　of life is, in a sense, mind control too.」

stage0072_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「I wonder if you should be saying that～」

stage0072_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「W-what is it, $$サザンカ$$...」

stage0072_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Miss $$ミレーヌ$$ met Captain $$ガムリン$$ through
　a matchmaking meeting her mother arranged, right?」

stage0072_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「How do you know that!?」

stage0072_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$アマタ$$
「He told me plenty more Fire Bomber rumors
　and legends than I ever wanted to hear」

stage0072_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Nnngh...!
　Fan or not, don't go digging into my privacy!」

stage0072_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「It's fine, Miss $$ミレーヌ$$.
　That's really how we met, after all」

stage0072_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「So obeying your parents isn't always a bad thing」

stage0072_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$タケル$$
「Yeah.
　My dad and mom raised me here on Earth,
　and they taught me how important it is to love」

stage0072_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Being able to say that so casually
　is your strength, $$タケル$$」

stage0072_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ガムリン$$
（That composure...
　I need to learn from it）

stage0072_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$アンディ$$
「The problem's $$グーラ$$.
　The way he just obeys his old man,
　he won't listen to $$正太郎$$」

stage0072_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$カイエン$$
「I doubt more persuading will do any good
　at this point...」

stage0072_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Once you give up, that's the end of it」

stage0072_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$カイエン$$
「What is with that guy...!」

stage0072_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Don't be so angry, $$カイエン$$.
　$$バサラ$$'s encouraging him in his own way」

stage0072_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Even so, I can't accept him
　putting it that way」

stage0072_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$レイ#168$$
「I'll apologize for him on that one.
　...He's a singer, after all.
　He just can't say how he feels, except in song」

stage0072_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$タケル$$
「Once you give up, that's the end, huh...
　But what he's saying is true」

stage0072_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$アンディ$$
「But put another way, that's just
　stating the obvious. Words like that
　won't put a dent in my heart」

stage0072_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$レイ#168$$
「We know better than anyone that he's
　a man who never gives up, right?」

stage0072_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Don't just hype yourselves up,
　throw the fans some more service!」

stage0072_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$レイ#168$$
「Alright, let's share an episode
　even Major $$オズマ$$ doesn't know」

stage0072_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$レイ#168$$
「$$バサラ$$'s the man who tried to move
　a mountain with song」

stage0072_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$シュレード$$
「I see...
　That's an episode just like him」

stage0072_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Could he really do something like that?」

stage0072_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「What's that supposed to mean!」

stage0072_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$アンディ$$
「So in the end, he couldn't do it!?」

stage0072_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$レイ#168$$
「I don't know the truth either.
　But countless people and things
　have been moved by $$バサラ$$'s song」

stage0072_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$正太郎$$
「What's wrong, $$モロイ$$!?
　Is it the enemy!」

stage0072_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Give me a break!
　I haven't even finished my homework,
　or had my snack yet!」

stage0072_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$モロイ$$
「Is this the time to say that!
　$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s massive army is
　headed for Odaiba!」

stage0072_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$...
　You're the one coming...」

stage0072_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ロビー$$
「Welcome back, Your Highness $$グーラ$$」

stage0072_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$ロビー$$
「That was unfortunate this time, wasn't it」

stage0072_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Mankind chose the path of despair
　on its own...」

stage0072_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ロビー$$
「In that case, let us watch humanity's
　final moments from here」

stage0072_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Gods and demons...
　That planet will become a battlefield
　once again...」

stage0072_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「O stars that fill the sky...!」

stage0072_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「O stars they call ill omens...!」

stage0072_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「At last, this moment has come...!」

stage0072_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「In the distant past...!
　O you who dreamed of this moment,
　when the 12,000-year ring of fate closes!」

stage0072_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「$$兜甲児$$!
　Let us greet our final moment together!!」

stage0072_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「W-what is it, $$ＡＧ$$...?
　Making that creepy voice...」

stage0072_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$ミレーヌ$$, you really are
　quite the heartbreaker」

stage0072_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Did you only just notice my beauty?
　Or maybe my angelic singing voice?
　Or this elegant body's charm, perhaps?」

stage0072_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no...
　I mean the love triangle between
　Master $$バサラ$$ and Master $$ガムリン$$」

stage0072_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「T-that's... I'm still thinking things
　over on that front!」

stage0072_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But, Master $$ミレーヌ$$...
　there is such a thing in this world
　as a spring that lasts too long...」

stage0072_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「What's that?
　Does it have something to do with
　$$エタニティ・フラット$$?」

stage0072_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's not it. It's when a man and
　woman with good chemistry spend ages
　with no progress, and never get together」

stage0072_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「T-that's... what does that have
　to do with me?」

stage0072_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Haven't you noticed?
　I'm talking about Master $$ガムリン$$」

stage0072_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$ガムリン$$... hasn't his heart
　been drifting elsewhere lately?」

stage0072_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Wh-what... is it charming Lieutenant $$エマ$$?
　Or maybe nice-bodied $$ヨーコ$$?
　Or mysterious $$入江$$ from $$２１世紀警備保障$$?」

stage0072_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Or is it petite, plump Ensign $$ミヒロ$$?
　Or suddenly going older, $$スメラギ$$?
　Or getting niche with $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ or $$モーム$$...?」

stage0072_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You don't get it, do you?
　The one in question is Master $$バサラ$$」

stage0072_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even settling on today's combination
　made Master $$ガムリン$$'s heart soar,
　producing 50 Z worth of Z-Chips」

stage0072_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, of course, I've already added
　this to the squad's stock」

stage0072_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「That's... $$ガムリン$$...
　just because I haven't given him
　a proper answer...」

stage0072_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For more details than that,
　please ask her about it」

stage0072_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「SAZANKAAAAA!!
　Is that your fantasy fuel again!?」

stage0072_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（That said, $$バサラ$$ x $$ガムリン$$
　was even a tabloid article once）

stage0072_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Someday, you really must give
　a proper answer, Master $$ミレーヌ$$...）

stage0072_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well done, Master $$ガムリン$$, Master $$レイ#168$$.
　You really shone this time」

stage0072_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$レイ#168$$
「Shouldn't you say that to $$バサラ$$?」

stage0072_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「True.
　$$バサラ$$'s song was practically
　what drove that man $$ミカゲ$$ off」

stage0072_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no...
　That's thanks to you two, who always
　support Master $$バサラ$$」

stage0072_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have always held your devoted
　support for him in high regard」

stage0072_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$レイ#168$$
「To have the unsung hero get
　the spotlight like this... it's kind
　of embarrassing」

stage0072_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「It's fine, isn't it?
　Once in a while, this is nice too」

stage0072_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Hold on a second!
　If it's about supporting $$バサラ$$,
　don't forget about me!」

stage0072_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$オズマ$$... saying that
　about yourself is a bit tactless」

stage0072_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$オズマ$$
「No! This is a good chance, let me say it!
　Every time, I write an incident report
　apologizing for $$バサラ$$'s battlefield antics!」

stage0072_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「I had no idea you were doing that...」

stage0072_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$オズマ$$
「But keep this quiet from $$バサラ$$」

stage0072_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$オズマ$$
「I don't want his singing weighed down
　by needless baggage」

stage0072_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$レイ#168$$
「Thank you for your consideration
　and support, Major」

stage0072_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, let's leave today to
　the three men who support $$熱気バサラ$$!」

stage0072_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Let's give it our all today too～!」
